conviction: 5/10 as an entry today, 6.5/10 business quality (one notch below DGX's 7 on the volume/margin gap), 7/10 as a stage on a $247-270 pullback. Clean & honest business, real margin expansion (+50-150bps), no impairment, RAISED FY26 guide — NOT a value trap. But NOT a bargain: fair vs own history. adjudication_lh_vs_dgx_vs_both.question: Is LH at ~15.4-15.6x the better price-disciplined expression, own LH now / DGX on pullback / BOTH / or LH cheap-for-a-reason?
adjudication_lh_vs_dgx_vs_both.answer: BOTH-LABS, each STAGED (not deploy). The naive 'own the cheaper twin now' thesis does NOT survive: valued on their own appropriate multiples, LH (-4.4%) and DGX (-2.8%) land in the same ~fair-to-slightly-rich zone at spot. LH is cheap for HALF a reason (earned by inferior organic volume + structural margin/mix) and rich-DGX for the other half. Neither is a deploy-at-spot. Split the lab slot: LH gets the fill-nearer-market GTC (price-discipline advantage + cleaner balance sheet), DGX keeps its deeper 30@199/45@189 resting bid (superior volume earns the pullback-wait).
adjudication_lh_vs_dgx_vs_both.why_not_LH_over_DGX_outright: DGX's premium is PARTIALLY EARNED: organic requisition volume +3.4% vs LH +1.1% (persistent both Q4-25 and Q1-26), and DGX organic REVENUE ~5.8% (vol 3.4 + mix 2.4) vs LH ~4.1%. Volume is the higher-quality growth signal (share/secular); DGX wins it decisively.
adjudication_lh_vs_dgx_vs_both.why_not_DGX_over_LH_outright: LH is LESS levered (net ~1.9x adj EBITDA vs DGX 3.37x gross), shrinks share faster (~2.2% vs ~1%), segment adj-op margins are strong (Dx 16.4%, BLS 16.1% — so the 445bp GROSS gap overstates the operating-quality gap), carries a genuine diversifier (BLS central-lab, backlog $8.72B, book-to-bill 1.09) DGX lacks, and trades at a real ~1-turn sentiment discount. At the same multiple they'd be a coin-flip; LH's price is more disciplined.
adjudication_lh_vs_dgx_vs_both.total_lab_exposure_recommendation: Combined lab slot cap ~$29-30k (~2.9-3.0% of the $1mm base): ~$14.5k LH + ~$14.5k DGX, roughly even. Do NOT let LH exceed DGX (LH is the lower-quality twin). This sits inside the ~$15k stated healthcare-axis room by design — the DGX ~$14.5k envelope was already planned; LH adds the second ~$14.5k, and BOTH are GTC-below-market so neither consumes capital until a pullback fills it.
